local_registration: Plan written before the first execution of this extension; not an external preregistration or an unseen-mechanism claim.
scope: Owned compiler/ELF fixtures: 18 hosts x 3 carrier representations x 4 predefined behavior cohorts per pass. TR01 is an ordinary removal-transform postcondition assessed before tested extraction. MR09 is extractor-focused and requires removal plus snapshot coherence. Same-information direct checks share recorded carrier observations and the parser family; no independent-parser or superior-oracle claim. Counts remain separate from the 14-relation/18,900-row matrices. Host semantics, external defects, ABA mutation and adversarial filesystem behavior are outside this extension.
failure_rules: Unavailable source/postcondition observation or failed transformation execution makes TR01 inadmissible. A completed no-op transform with a valid residual carrier is inconsistent. Missing or changing follow-up evidence makes MR09 inadmissible; no early stop is counted as a pass.

cohort_mechanisms.accepted-after-removal: Existing M09 fallback payload after rejection
cohort_mechanisms.restored-during-extraction: Owned fixture restores the original bytes at entry to follow-up extraction
